_meta.meaning: Candidate venture architecture ordered by capital intensity. These bands do not report the domain's current P0-P10 state and do not authorize a business or external effect.
_meta.fundingRule: A higher band may be funded only from measured surplus below it or from a separately approved Finance or owner-capital contract.

bands.label: Observe and attract
bands.revenue: attention, referrals, affiliate or lead revenue
